rationale: Choroidal melanoma is a subtype of uveal melanoma arising specifically in the choroid; it is defined by this ocular site, a proper subset of the code's whole-body ceiling.

rationale: Ring melanoma is a rare variant of anterior uveal melanoma involving the ciliary body and iris circumferentially (ICD-O C694). Restricted to this ocular site.

rationale: Uveal melanoma arises from the uveal tract (choroid, ciliary body, iris); choroid=C693 and ciliary body/iris=C694. Restricted to the uvea, a proper subset of the ceiling.
